cycles.diagnosis: Commas in lambda varargslist were treated as top-level split delimiters, causing Black to split lambda parameters instead of splitting at safer expression boundaries.

file_inspections.reason: Confirm failing lambda formatting case and expected stable formatting shape.
Verify diff expectation around the lambda expression and related formatting behavior.
Inspect delimiter classification and split logic controlling comma-based line splits.

patch_attempt.patch_summary: Updated is_split_after_delimiter() to ignore commas whose parent is syms.varargslist, preventing delimiter_split from splitting lambda parameter lists.

test_rerun.command: pipenv run python -m unittest tests.test_black.BlackTestCase.test_expression tests.test_black.BlackTestCase.test_expression_ff tests.test_black.BlackTestCase.test_piping_diff ; pipenv run python setup.py test
